summary: Level sealed campus car park with parked cars, bush around, no dwellings.
reasons: Bush to the west and east

best_section.where: East edge of the small sealed car park north of the Cycad building

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west and east sides; only university buildings nearby, the nearest right beside the south end, none residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot with a road in from the north; marked bays and several parked cars, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Low; campus car park, daytime activity.
drivers.convention: Cars park here and in the lot next door, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Cycad building adjoins the south end, non-residential
Mapped gates nearby have ways round
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun, with tree shade from the west and east edges.
